description: A nine drawbar organ on the Hammond footages, with a phase modulation input weighted toward the lower drawbars

params.text: Sets the level of that footage in the mix, 0 to 100 per cent, taken as a square root so the middle of the travel is louder than half

inputs.text: Adds to that footage's level, ten per cent per volt
Sets the pitch of the 1 foot drawbar, one octave per volt from C4 at 261.63Hz, and is the only pitch control the module has
Bends the phase of every drawbar, weighted by its footage so the 16 foot is moved sixteen times as far as the 1 foot

outputs.text: The nine drawbars added together, each of them a triangle

notes: there is no pitch knob: with nothing patched to the frequency input the 1 foot drawbar sounds at C4 and the organ cannot be tuned from the panel
every drawbar comes up at the level its own footage gives on a sixteen to one taper, so a new module makes sound as soon as a pitch reaches it
